item.title: Twin-Engine 1961 McCulloch R1 Go-Kart at No Reserve
item.description: This 1961 McCulloch R1 go-kart is powered by a pair of 7.3ci McCulloch MC75 two-stroke singles, and the two-piece steel frame is finished in yellow with a black vinyl seat. Equipment includes Max-Torque centrifugal clutches, chromed shrouds, Tillotson carburetors, a chrome seatback-mounted fuel tank, Palmini exhausts, a three-spoke steering wheel, McCulloch-branded pedals, a rear disc brake, and 5″ Tristar magnesium wheels. item.title: 17k-Mile 1997 Ford F-350 XLT Crew Cab Power Stroke 4×4 at No Reserve
item.description: This 1997 Ford F-350 XLT is a Crew Cab 4×4 pickup that has 17k miles and remained registered to its original owner in Illinois until 2025. It is finished in Oxford White over gray cloth and is powered by a turbodiesel 7.3-liter Power Stroke V8 linked to a four-speed automatic transmission and a dual-range transfer case. item.title: 50k-Mile 2003 Toyota Celica GT-S
item.description: This 2003 Toyota Celica GT-S is equipped with the Action Package, which provided aerodynamic lower bodywork and a rear spoiler. The car also left the factory with 16" alloy wheels, a power sunroof, a CD/cassette radio, and a JBL audio system, and it is powered by a 1.8-liter DOHC inline-four linked with a four-speed Sportshift semi-automatic transaxle. item.title: 2020 Audi R8 V10 Coupe
item.description: This 2020 Audi R8 V10 coupe was specified in Mythos Black Metallic over black Nappa leather with Express Red stitching, and it was optioned with the Full Leather Package. The car remained in the original owner's care until earlier this year, and it has 22k miles following registration history in California. item.description: This 2018 Porsche Panamera 4 Sport Turismo remained registered in California from the time it was new until it was purchased by its current owner on BaT in November 2024. Powered by a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 that drives all four wheels through an eight-speed PDK dual-clutch automatic transmission, the car is finished in black over matching leather upholstery. item.title: 1964 Jaguar XKE Series I 3.8 Coupe
item.description: This 1964 Jaguar XKE Series I coupe was refurbished in 2024 and is powered by a 3.8-liter inline-six linked to a Moss four-speed manual transmission and a limited-slip differential. Finished in Cream over dark blue leather, the car is equipped with enclosed headlights, 15″ wire-spoke wheels, Wilwood front disc brakes, Spax shocks, and triple windshield wipers. item.title: One-Owner 2017 Lotus Evora 400 2+2 6-Speed
item.description: This 2017 Lotus Evora 400 2+2 was acquired new in California by its current owner, and it now has 43k miles. item.title: Original-Owner, 8k-Mile 1996 Porsche 911 Turbo
item.description: This 1996 Porsche 911 Turbo was specified in Arena Red Metallic over Flamenco Red full leather and was purchased new by the current owner at Beechmont Motors in Cincinnati, Ohio. The vehicle was optioned with supple leather seat upholstery, a CD player, aluminum-look instrument dials, stainless-steel trim, and leather-edged floor mats. item.title: 1976 Pontiac LeMans Sport Coupe 350

Inside, white vinyl upholstery is complemented by woodgrain trim, a center console, air conditioning, an aftermarket eight-track player, and Bosch supplementary gauges.
